findings.text: Trust hashes mutable disk contents instead of the verified login payload. VM reproduction: replace the project bytes after login's rename with another URL/token; output: exit=0, trustedReplacement=true, verifiedOnlyOriginal=true. A writer with checkout access can therefore authorize an unverified identity (focus 1/5). Bind trust to the exact bytes and path produced from the verified credentials; reject replacement rather than hashing it.

The trust-list read/modify/rename is unlocked, so atomic rename still loses concurrent updates (acceptance 3, focus 4). VM reproduction: pause writer A after reading the list, complete B, resume A; output: completed=2, paths=[existing,a], lostEntry=b. Serialize the whole update with a lock respected by both login.mjs and atalk, and test overlapping writers; coordinating atalk needs a shared-task scope change.

Acceptance 7 preflight checks only symlinks, and never checks the trust-list target. VM tests: a directory .gitignore yields exit=1/EISDIR with credentialExists=true and trustExists=true; a FIFO credential target is replaced; a symlink trust list is silently replaced. Refuse every existing non-regular output with lstat before any write, including the trust list, and roll back/clean temporary files if later writes fail so a failed login cannot leave an unignored credential.

Remote HTTP is accepted and receives the bearer token without TLS (focus 5). VM reproduction with the unchanged login/API modules and a fetch spy: --url http://remote.example yields requestUrl=http://remote.example/api/me, bearerSent=true, exit=0. A network observer can steal the credential before verification. Require HTTPS for non-loopback servers before sending any request, and test that rejected URLs make zero requests.

Unknown arguments echo secrets, violating G3 even though the supported literal-token form is redacted. Direct reproduction: node integrations/claude-code-plugin/scripts/login.mjs --token=atk_review_synthetic_0001 exits 1 and prints unknown argument "--token=atk_review_synthetic_0001" to stderr. Do not echo arbitrary argument values; reject token-bearing argument forms with a fixed diagnostic and add a regression assertion that the synthetic token is absent.
